orchestrationTrigger: Use child workspaces: one per work item, then merge each into this branch.
notes: Calibrated 2026-11-14 on Recur 0.7.2 (release build, notarized, universal) at 1600x1000 points.

Settings: no seed. steps.configure pins them with the bundled CLI while the app is open (Recur 0.7.0+): recur-cli config set modelAgent claude-code/${model}, flagsAgent {"effort":"${effort}"}, bypassPermissions true. Factory values are Sonnet 5.5 and bypass off. Simplify stays at its factory default (on). The values persist in recur.db after quit.

openProject: recur-cli open <worktree> finds or creates the project and opens its Working copy with one 'New chat' tab in Agent mode. cmd+1 (Focus agent) focuses the composer; probe-region read 299,900,547,50.
newThread cmd+t (File > New Tab) appends a chat tab at the end with the composer focused (probe-region found the same rect without a click).

Relaunch restores the project, its tabs and composer focus; focusClick 570,915 is inside the composer and only a safety click. steps.quit is empty (AppleScript quit); no recur process survives a quit.
threadRect 285,115,575,760 is the whole message column: Recur lays a thread out from the top, so a short answer sits near y 220.

A11: the long thread is the last chat tab and the seed thread the one before it. longThread is cmd+9 (Navigate > Last Tab, Recur 0.7.1+); shortThread is cmd+9 then cmd+alt+left (Previous Tab). Previous/Next Tab alone are relative and wrap, so a repeated switch drifts.
Masks stay empty: GPUI repaints the whole window.

Orchestration (C1): the trigger is the line documented in the Recur docs (Concepts > Chat modes > Child workspaces). Workers are child workspaces: their own worktrees under ~/.recur/worktrees and their own claude sessions. Claude Code subagents (Agent tool) are disallowed in Recur chats.
